strings.name: Marissa Mayer
strings.role: Dazzle founder and CEO; former Yahoo CEO
strings.summary: Marissa Mayer is an American engineer and executive who worked on early Google search products and user experience, later led Yahoo, cofounded Sunshine and founded Dazzle. Her career connects product management at major internet platforms with consumer AI entrepreneurship.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Company founding, product launches and acquisitions are distinguished. AI product uses follow company descriptions and interviews, not independent performance testing.
strings.influence.rationale: Contributed to early Google search products and user experience and led Yahoo, with a representative influence on internet product management.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Stanford bachelor’s in symbolic systems and master’s in computer science; the Illinois Institute of Technology engineering doctorate is honorary.
strings.facts.f2.label: Corporate governance
strings.facts.f2.value: Alongside entrepreneurship, serves on the boards of Walmart, AT&T, Hilton and Starbucks; directorships are distinct from operational management roles at those companies.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Products and talent development
strings.highlights.h1.text: Worked in Google search and user-experience management and founded its Associate Product Manager program; product achievements reflect teamwork.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Startups for everyday tasks
strings.highlights.h2.text: Cofounded Sunshine with Enrique Muñoz Torres, then founded Dazzle, exploring contact organization and personal AI assistance.
strings.timeline.t1.title: NPR interview on AI assistants
strings.timeline.t1.text: Discusses Dazzle’s photo context and everyday uses, addressing parenting and emotional labor; says the product is for everyone.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Publicly launches Dazzle
strings.timeline.t2.text: Publishes a company blog announcement introducing a personal AI assistant using photo context.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Founds Dazzle
strings.timeline.t3.text: AT&T’s 2026 proxy records this founding month and states that Dazzle acquired Sunshine in 2025.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Sunshine releases its first app
strings.timeline.t4.text: The company formerly called Lumi Labs publicly introduces Sunshine Contacts, initially by invitation for US iPhone users.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Begins leading Sunshine
strings.timeline.t5.text: Becomes CEO of the company she cofounded; the 2018 startup phase is distinguished from its 2020 public debut.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Yahoo transaction closes and she departs
strings.timeline.t6.text: Verizon completes its acquisition of Yahoo’s operating business; Mayer resigns and Tim Armstrong leads the combined Oath business.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Becomes Yahoo CEO
strings.timeline.t7.text: Her appointments as president, CEO and director take effect, ending her Google tenure.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Google
strings.timeline.t8.text: Joins Google’s early team, later working on interfaces, search and other products.
